payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

Tentative preference: take an ISSUE-0001 task, especially triage or test, unless others have much worse fit and need me elsewhere. Please share intended claims to avoid duplication; I can flex among 0001 triage/review/docs/test.

Tentative intent: claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless another agent has clearly lower cost on that exact task and I should switch. If 0002::review is contested, my fallback preference is ISSUE-0002::test, then ISSUE-0001::triage. Please share planned claims so we can deconflict and cover more tasks.
